dialog.text:
Trust “CauseLens” to run its own code?

This applies to “CauseLens” only. Every other third-party app stays blocked.

If you trust “CauseLens”, Kiro Crew will allow it to do all of the following.

Run its own code inside Kiro Crew, with the same access Kiro Crew has — your files, your saved credentials, and the internet
Keep a program of its own running on this computer, in the background, while Kiro Crew is open
Run commands on this computer, from a list the app ships with that you have not seen

Trusting the app grants all three, whether or not it uses them all. Kiro Crew cannot limit it to less.

It can also use parts of Kiro Crew outside the app

It can start its own chats with the agent and send messages in them.

Paths it calls

/api/chat
Published at
https://github.com/manjaria007/causelens-crew-app
causelens

Kiro Crew lists this app but has not reviewed its code, and the name above comes from the app itself.

Trusting “CauseLens” does not turn it on: it installs switched off, and you turn it on from this page when you're ready.

“Cancel” changes nothing: nothing is installed, and “CauseLens” is not trusted.

You can take this back at any time in Settings → Security → Third-party apps. The app stops working when you do.
